summary.intent: Complete Workstream 2 of the onboarding-friction PR (best-effort stderr, closed-stdout handling, git process-count oracles), then, at the lead session's request, also fix four adjacent gaps: batch pre.json per-package history lookups, init README/config write ordering, `help` on closed stdout, and narrowing the docs promise.
summary.outcome: Workstream 2 was committed as signed 3074e784c and passed the full gate. Items 1-4 were then implemented test-first, formatted and clippy-checked, and committed signed; the final sha is not shown. Still not done: merging origin/main, the full gate re-run (with bench), another codex review round, and reporting the sha.

repo: Advisory stderr goes through `callisto_graph::note::advise` (re-exported as `output::advise`), and stdout goes through `output::stdout()` / `color::stdout()`. Both treat a closed pipe as best-effort, while real write failures still fail.
The lints `print_stdout`/`print_stderr` (denied) and a disallowed `std::io::stdout` replace the old source-scanning `println!` test.

Git process-count tests use tags at 0.9.0 with manifests at 1.0.0 and compare Auto against a Changeset control, under modern Git and simulated pre-2.44 tag listing. Positive controls prove the oracles can actually fail.

`history::declaring_at` used to run one `git grep` per package for v2 `pre.json` keyed by npm names. `version --dry-run` had this cost on main, and #242's pending hint carried it into `release --dry-run`.
Specs live in docs/specs/cli.json (CLI-OUT-09/10, CLI-INIT-15). Error help text is checked against docs/errors.md by hygiene/architecture tests, so changing E278 help needs that file kept in sync.
Changes need a changeset under .changeset/, which can be generated with `callisto add --package ... --summary ...`.
Gate commands are `just pre-push`, `lint`, `doc-check`, `test` and `bench`; `fuzz-check` is only needed when public signatures in callisto-model or callisto-manifests change.

code.finding: `files_containing_at` now takes `&[&str]` needles, emits one `-e` per needle in a single `git grep`, and returns empty for no needles. Existing tests were migrated and a multi-needle test was added.

`Rosters` gained an `expected` names map and a `texts` cache. The first `declaring_at` miss at a revision searches all expected names in one grep and then batch-reads the matching manifests via `prefetch`. A test with a counting runner asserts 1 grep for expected names and 2 when an unexpected name is added.
`PreJsonOrigin` now carries the pre.json keys and calls `rosters.expect_names(rev, keys)` when it resolves the commit that added pre.json.
`init` was reordered so `callisto.toml` is written only after the required `.changeset/README.md` succeeds. A README failure leaves no config, so a retry works.

workflow: Failing-first tests proved each fix: process counts went 27 vs 55 before the batch, and `help` returned E213 on closed stdout before the sink change.
The lead session widened scope mid-task through a cross-session message, so a boundary decision on an out-of-scope P2 finding became an assigned task.
The final gate was run from a script that logs each recipe's exit code to a file, run in the background, and the logs were read afterwards.
Findings were reproduced and checked against git history (whether the file changed on the branch) before deciding they were this PR's regression.

friction: The ledger had no rows for 6HAHVX or VDYV5B, so the work came from the brief and handoff.
The codex P2 fell outside the original workstream boundary, which forced a pause and a decision request.
Moving 6 `eprintln!` advisories in callisto-graph (including during real publish) went beyond the handoff's file list.
The commit tooling printed progress noise (▮/Tasks/Time) that had to be filtered from output.
open_items: Merge origin/main (was 39a70f311) right before the push, then re-run the full gate by exit code, including `just bench`.
Run `codex review --base origin/main` again until nothing is actionable, then report the final signed commit sha to close-gap-for-alpha. Nothing is to be pushed.
Add a ledger row for the pre.json history finding, if it is still tracked separately.
`just fuzz-check` and `just ci` were not run, and the earlier decision that fuzz-check was unnecessary should be rechecked since `files_containing_at` in callisto-model changed signature.
Required narration, such as JSON init facts on stderr, stays fallible by design, and the docs narrowing for that should be verified in cli.json.
